ModMetaData.name: Wake-Up: Loading Optimizations
ModMetaData.author: kt-nyx
ModMetaData.description:
Wake-Up 1.7 development preview. Startup optimizations are disabled because repeated cloud comparisons did not establish a reliable loading-time benefit. Native RimWorld loading is used, including for profiles with previously enabled preview settings. No Wake-Up search or deferred-loading patches are installed.
Exact build checks remain for the reviewed 1.7.4982 rev1280 and recorded Harmony 3.0.0-rc.3 build. Does not require or support Prepatcher on 1.7. Existing preview preferences are preserved without activating features.
No loading-time improvement is claimed. Final Windows verification, played installation and binary/tag/Workshop release remain local and owner-controlled. Not authorized for publication.
